question: Which three years in 2012-2017 have the smallest absolute difference between median revenue and median functional expenses for organizations filing IRS 990 forms? Please output three years and respective differences.
sql:
WITH all_years AS (
  SELECT '2012' AS yr, ein, totrevenue, totfuncexpns FROM `bigquery-public-data.irs_990.irs_990_2012`
  UNION ALL SELECT '2013', ein, totrevenue, totfuncexpns FROM `bigquery-public-data.irs_990.irs_990_2013`
  UNION ALL SELECT '2014', ein, totrevenue, totfuncexpns FROM `bigquery-public-data.irs_990.irs_990_2014`
  UNION ALL SELECT '2015', ein, totrevenue, totfuncexpns FROM `bigquery-public-data.irs_990.irs_990_2015`
  UNION ALL SELECT '2016', ein, totrevenue, totfuncexpns FROM `bigquery-public-data.irs_990.irs_990_2016`
  UNION ALL SELECT '2017', ein, totrevenue, totfuncexpns FROM `bigquery-public-data.irs_990.irs_990_2017`
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT yr, totrevenue, totfuncexpns
  FROM all_years
  WHERE totrevenue IS NOT NULL
    AND totfuncexpns IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT yr, totrevenue, totfuncexpns,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY yr ORDER BY totrevenue) AS rev_rank,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY yr ORDER BY totfuncexpns) AS exp_rank,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY yr) AS cnt
  FROM filtered
),
medians AS (
  SELECT yr,
    AVG(CASE WHEN rev_rank IN (DIV(cnt, 2) + 1, DIV(cnt, 2) + 2) THEN SAFE_CAST(totrevenue AS FLOAT64) END) AS median_revenue,
    AVG(CASE WHEN exp_rank IN (DIV(cnt, 2) + 1, DIV(cnt, 2) + 2) THEN SAFE_CAST(totfuncexpns AS FLOAT64) END) AS median_expenses
  FROM ranked
  GROUP BY yr
)
SELECT yr, median_revenue, median_expenses,
  ABS(median_revenue - median_expenses) AS abs_diff
FROM medians
ORDER BY abs_diff
LIMIT 3
